patches.reason: Read checkout identity without computing full status during reconciliation.
patches.removalCondition: The selected stable release includes identity-only checkout reads.

patches.name: workspace-git-snapshot-retention
patches.reason: Retain workspace Git snapshots across reconnects so clients read the last known state immediately and the daemon revalidates once instead of running a full initial refresh for every workspace.
patches.removeWhen: Upstream ships workspace Git snapshot retention across reconnects or fixes issue #7760.

adaptation: Replay the four deployed 0.14.0 patches onto the actual v0.15.3 release. Preserve both reconciliation test setups by taking the approved union of Vitest imports. No watcher-recovery or Git-concurrency changes are included.

runtimeBuild.tagRule: The complete first 12 characters of the composition commit.

sourcePolicy: Local-only maintained source. No remote source publication.
